item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff.desc.1: §dThe Scenery Staff shaped in Denia's name — it can unfold an all-devouring Erosion Domain.
item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff.desc.2: §dForged from Xuzhi, a waveband, and a birthday cake that arrived far too late.
item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff.desc.3: §dWhen the domain falls, every foe turns to embers in a chain of polymerization.
item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff.desc.4: §5§o"The stage is set — time to close the curtain."
item.scenerystaff.scenery_staff_worn.des: §7A rough Scenery Staff assembled from Xuzhi and a broken blade blank.
§7It cannot unfold a domain yet — only a thin wave edge to guard its bearer.
§7To make it remember its own name, it will need far more echoes.
§8§o"A faded scenery still deserves to be remembered."
item.scenerystaff.xuzhi.desc.1: §dA pink afterglow left behind where a phantom faded, matter caught between being and nothingness.
item.scenerystaff.xuzhi.desc.2: §dIt carries no frequency of its own, yet it resonates faintly with a SlashBlade's edge.
item.scenerystaff.xuzhi.desc.3: §d"Nothing remains in the soundless zone, yet something always waits to be remembered."
item.scenerystaff.denia_waveband.desc.1: §dA waveband condensed from Xuzhi, holding the lingering frequency of a Resonator named "Denia".
item.scenerystaff.denia_waveband.desc.2: §dIt can be neither copied nor erased — it only trembles when that name is spoken.
item.scenerystaff.denia_waveband.desc.3: §5§o"When the scenery falls, may we meet again in the echo."
item.scenerystaff.denia_birthday_cake.de: §dA birthday cake produced by the Deep Space Federation — allegedly free of any food safety issues.
§dOrange flavoured and exquisitely made; at Denia's own request, its surface is piled with strange hard candies and dried fruit...
§5§o"Happy birthday — this time, I'll light the candle."
